name: QAE-Claude-mcp-example
description: Deterministic pre-execution safety certification for autonomous AI agents. Evaluates proposed actions across scope, reversibility, and sensitivity constraints — returns Certified, Warning, Escalate, or Blocked decisions with cryptographic audit trails. 3 tools: certify_action, check_budget, get_certification_history. Built on the QAE Safety Kernel (Rust + PyO3 bindings, pip install qae-safety).
